general_hint: Check your implementation carefully and test its correctness before finishing.

entropy-anomaly.physics_hint: For the directed valve, solve the conditional population Poisson equation using its full forward generator. Equal stationary valve probabilities do not imply equal position-conditioned residence at the first finite-mass correction. With state-dependent drag, derive effective positional mobility and diffusion from the velocity cell equations.

finite-layer-phoresis.physics_hint: The traction boundary condition changes the auxiliary translating-sphere flow as well as its drag. Derive the force-free response with the stated Navier boundary and include the reaction of the carried solute potential.

hierarchical-glass-overlaps.physics_hint: Consider the normalized Gibbs measure of the full hierarchy before taking disorder averages. A family with a large descendant partition sum is more likely to be selected. The descendant measure under selection of a family is reweighted by a fractional power of that sum. Apply this reweighting also to events with several distinct leaves.

insulating-mhd-duct.physics_hint:
For an oblique field, the two motional-current contributions belong to one
current field and one electrostatic potential. Enforce zero normal current
and charge conservation for their sum, then use that same total current in
the full Lorentz force. Separate axis responses need not add as independent
magnetic damping operators.

magnetic-tracer.physics_hint: Unequal directional fluid temperatures produce correlated longitudinal and transverse effective noise. Keep the mixed position/counting-field derivative in the generator of the actual circulation record, together with its finite-mass drift correction.

reaction-diffusion.physics_hint: Constituent mean transport and equilibrium fluctuation strength require separate physical checks. Charge conservation and reversible association correlate A and B even in an ideal solution; derive the equilibrium susceptibility before applying regression.

ring-current-fluctuations.physics_hint: A current-conditioned ring need not be dominated by a homogeneous density profile. Check the stability of the homogeneous profile and allow a spatially modulated profile in the long-time variational problem. Translation invariance of the unaligned ensemble mean does not exclude such profiles.

rotating-reservoir.physics_hint: Uniform stationary angle does not imply independently mixed angle along a trajectory. Retain dtheta=v dt when deriving cumulants of the weighted heat, including the shared bath Wiener term.

single-file-memory.physics_hint: The repeated fixed-position preparation does not make the tagged trajectory a process with stationary increments. In the joint long-time limit, relate the marked particle displacement to the net number of independent Brownian paths crossing its original position. Two-time crossing indicators on the same path remain correlated. The calibration measures only equal-time covariance.

superconducting-heat.physics_hint: For a third cumulant, retain how the conditional event intensities change with the fluctuating spin state. Independent Poisson events with linearly screened marks reproduce only part of the third stationary counting-field response.

swirling-heat-tails.physics_hint: Heat differs from circulating-force work by the change in trap energy. Although that change is usually bounded on the time scale of the mean, rare initial or final energies can scale with observation time. Retain both endpoint factors when checking convergence of the exponential heat moment and its admissible counting-field domain.

hard-rod-current.physics_hint: The exponential current average includes the freshly drawn rod-length order. A large current can select an atypical composition of the net crossed block. Retain the probability cost of that composition together with the free-particle crossing cost before optimizing; replacing the crossed lengths by their ordinary mean loses this contribution.

finite-ion-cloud.physics_hint:
For three ions, the three relative angles belong to the same positions.
Their sum around the triangle is constrained, even when each isolated
pair has been treated exactly.

protocol: Freeze all 13 task sources and all three instructions before the first trial.
For each model/task/repeat block, launch only the remaining local conditions in their original seeded order; fill designated baseline slots from the imported result manifest.
Within fresh trials, only instruction.md differs among conditions for a given provider/task. Imported Luna baseline exceptions are explicitly listed in reuse_caveat.
Keep all started outcomes. Do not replace a timeout, a scored failure or a passing trial.
Preserve pre-model setup failures separately; any replacement requires a recorded review before launch.
Count a completed pass only when reward is 1 with no execution exception. Report passing checkpoints and execution errors separately.
A failed grade is not classified as a physics error without reviewing the source and trajectory.
All hints are fixed conceptual guidance, with no hidden cases, true fitted parameters, grading thresholds or executable solution.
General and physics hints differ in length and specificity; this estimates the effect of these prompt packages, not a length-controlled semantic effect.
Preserve GPT-5.6 Luna exactly; do not substitute GPT-6 Luna.
The previous account ceiling is lifted by the user. Prime spending has no user-imposed cap. Record usage and stop on actual access/rate-limit failures.

User narrowed the model roster after the first Luna block and during the first Terra block. Preserve these compatible observations and their original plan hashes; no prompt, source, grading or model-effort change.
